approval: T62 D5/D8; r5 A timing and T61 native-verified P0
timing_sdc:
# Main clock stays at 125 MHz; capture/configuration/RAM/output paths keep 8 ns.
create_clock -name clk -period 8.000 [get_ports {clk}]
# T51 过约束：只收紧 setup 目标 0.30 ns，让布局布线按 7.7 ns 努力；签核仍按 8 ns
# （实现报告的 slack 已扣掉这 0.30 ns，真实余量 = 报告值 + 0.30 ns）。hold 不加不确定度。
set_clock_uncertainty -setup 0.30 [get_clocks {clk}]

# Register-only groups follow actual mapped fan-in, avoiding a dense all-to-all matrix.
# Refresh with the netlist checker after RTL changes; all internal arcs must be covered.
# Native eLinx hold 0 preserves the same-edge check (conventional SDC setup 2 / hold 1).
